description: 한국도로공사_고속도로 차종분류(AVC) 원시 데이터(15분 단위) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국도로공사. 데이터에는 수집 시각, 검지 지점, 차종 코드, 차량 통과 건수 등이 포함되어 있으며, 고속도로 교통량 분석, 이용 패턴 파악, 요금 정책 수립, 도로 설계 계획 수립, 교통 흐름. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국도로공사. Its tags are AVC, 원시, 15분, 교통량분석, 자동분류. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
